concept: KMS + CloudTrail: centralized key management and key-usage auditing
tests: Choosing services for centralized key management, access control and logging of every key use.
expected: AWS KMS — keys with key policies and IAM; CloudTrail logs every KMS API call (Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey). Triggers: "centrally manage and audit encryption keys", "control who can use", "log every key usage".
why_not: S3 default encryption — uses keys but isn't a management/audit system; keys in DynamoDB — a homegrown, insecure solution; Secrets Manager stores secrets, not cryptographic keys for operations.
